name: green-level-label-visible-off
note: G6 OFF side. Same source as green-level-label-visible-on, run with {"show": false}: geometry is BYTE-IDENTICAL and only the label/text disappear. This is the property gating the SPAWN condition could never express -- there the line and zone would vanish with their labels. The pair's two runs differ ONLY in the inputs record, so any divergence in x1/x2/price/top/bottom is a defect in the visibility gate, not in geometry.
source:
indicator("V", shorttitle="V", overlay=true)
show = input.bool(true, "Show Labels")
plotlevel(bar_index == 2, close, "L", label="R1", label_visible=show, extend=extend.bars, bars=1)
plotzone(bar_index == 2, high, low, "Z", text="OB", text_visible=show, extend=extend.bars, bars=1)
